verdict.rationale: The only commitment-related evidence is that customers can transact through the AWS and GCP marketplaces to apply existing cloud committed spend to Modal. That is a procurement path that draws down a cloud-provider commitment. It is not a Modal-offered reserved-capacity or committed-use discount on sustained GPU capacity, so it is adjacent and earns no credit. No evidence shows Modal itself offering reserved GPU pricing or commit-based discounts.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can lock in reserved or committed-use discounts for sustained GPU capacity
